acceptance.given: A defined six-case Stable/Candidate replay matrix and its case-execution evidence are supplied to the Toolchain replay path.

oracle.expected: For every Matrix Case, verification establishes a case-unique fixture identity or state-transition identity, a frozen case expectation, one Stable execution, one Candidate execution, and two separately attributable observations; no such identity or observation is reused as another case's owned context.
forbidden: Any two Matrix Cases share a fixture or state-transition identity.
Any Matrix Case lacks its frozen expectation, Stable execution, Candidate execution, or separate observations.
oracle.observable: The S2 matrix verification emits per-case structural evidence binding the case ID to its owned fixture/state-transition identity, frozen expectation, Stable and Candidate execution records, and separate observation records.

acceptance.then: The matrix is accepted only when every case independently satisfies the complete ownership tuple.
acceptance.when: The authored S2 runtime matrix selector evaluates the replay evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S2 selector after assigning two Matrix Cases the same fixture or state-transition identity; observe structural rejection.
Run the S2 selector after removing one Matrix Case's frozen expectation; observe structural rejection.
Run the S2 selector after omitting one subject execution or one separately attributable observation from a Matrix Case; observe aggregate rejection.

affected_subjects: Matrix Case fixture or state-transition ownership
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require the Toolchain matrix replay path to reject a Matrix Case unless it owns a fixture or state transition distinct from every other case and binds its frozen expectation, both Stable/Candidate executions, and separate observations.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing replay receipt contract and non-authorizing lifecycle semantics; remove only the added ownership validation if rollback is required.

slice_hint.state_transition: A defined or evaluated Matrix Case moves from unverified case metadata to independently owned fixture/state-transition evidence with frozen expectation, two subject executions, and separate observations.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S2 selector passes only if all six Matrix Cases have pairwise distinct owned fixture-or-state-transition contexts and each case has its own frozen expectation, Stable execution, Candidate execution, and separate observations; otherwise the aggregate is unsuccessful.
